payload.explanation: The business UPDATE (session_88d1f7ef881b, pid 1608) is active and waiting on a transactionid lock, with pg_blocking_pids pointing to pid 1609 (session_b99668892165). That blocker is 'idle in transaction' after having executed the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1, so it holds the row lock on product_id=1 and is waiting on ClientRead without committing. No evidence of large data, index issues, or vacuum problems (table has only a PK index, tiny row counts). Root cause is an uncommitted transaction holding the row lock; remediation is rolling back the eligible blocker session per policy. Uncertainty: none material; blocker identity is directly observed via blocking_session_ids in the activity view.
